name: DuckDB
description: Inspect and analyze local structured files with read-only SQL, including aggregations and joins.

inspect.description: Inspect inferred columns, types and a five-row sample of local data files.
inspect.progressive_guidance: Use the returned column names and types when building SQL.

paths.description: Existing local paths; ~ expands to the owner home.

query.description: Run one read-only SELECT or CTE query against named local file sources.
query.progressive_guidance: Prefer SQL aggregation to returning every row. Quote unusual table/column names with double quotes. Returned rows are bounded; truncated=true means the row preview is incomplete. Native large integer/decimal values may be returned as strings to preserve precision.

name.description: Unique SQL table name, e.g. orders.

path.description: Local CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON or Parquet file.

sql.description: One SELECT, optionally WITH CTEs. Query the declared table names; no writes or multiple statements.

progressive_guidance: Supports local CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, NDJSON and Parquet. Each call uses an ephemeral in-memory database. Only declared files are accessible; network access, extension loading and writes are unavailable. SELECT validation uses DuckDB’s parser. Memory and row limits come from settings; the execution timeout is built in. Output overflow is an error, never a complete empty result.
